record_note: For MB1137 NUCLEO-F746ZG, the default HSE is the fixed 8 MHz ST-LINK MCO; the 8 MHz X3 crystal is not provided. The 32.768 kHz X2 LSE is the documented default. ST lists the board as out of production. Exact board revision, solder-bridge state, pin reservations, and build/flash profiles remain open.
